$comment: Recipes = knowledge (CONTRACT §8.4, §9). Every recipe id is a knowledge id. kind: craft (inputs -> items), gather (unlocks a gathering task and what it yields), idea (pure knowledge), build (unlocks building types). inputs/tools by item id or tag; place: needs = contexts that must ALL be present (building provides, resources, 'fire'), heat = minimum °C of a fire/hearth/kiln/furnace in reach, near = any one of these resource contexts within reach. knowledge = prerequisites (ALL). outputs: items, buildings (now buildable), knowledge (also granted on learning: alternative paths). time = ticks of work; skill = skill group; difficulty 0..1 (failure / waste chance for novices). discover: base = chance per experiment session, triggers = contexts or accident events that make it far likelier (and fire accidents for nearby knowers of the prerequisites), curiosity = how much the experimenter's curiosity matters. teach = difficulty of passing it on (0 trivial .. 1 very hard). era orders the paths but forces nothing. enables = tasks/abilities; effect = passive multipliers; writes = the product is a written record (books into a library); species = only these peoples can learn it; secret = tendency to be hoarded (0..1).

recipes.name: Forestry
recipes.desc: Tending and replanting the woods: cut, and plant again (the god layer regrows a forestry settlement's woods).
